title: Tandem Parasailing Experience in Kelowna
includes: All safety equipment including life jackets and harnesses
All taxes, fees and handling charges
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
11 years old below must be accompanied by an adult
Refunds will not be issued if tour/activity is missed due to late or non-arrival
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy and parasailing experience with your friends. The price is per person, Parasailing is the most popular Family activity in Kelowna during the summer months. Parasail is a safe and easy way for anyone aged 4 to 94 to get out on Lake Okanagan and step of you comfort zone a little. There is no experience and no swimming required. Every ride starts and finishes right from the back of the boat. If we have room on the boat viewers are welcome to come and take photo's or you can purchase one of our photo or video packages. We have been parasailing in North America since 2002 and have a 100% safety record.
